gallery.title: Review a GitHub repository
gallery.description: Type a repository, such as itsfja/second-thought. An agent reads it through GitHub's own MCP server (tree, README, main files, issues) and writes an assessment, from concept to extensibility, every point naming the file or issue it came from. A review checks nothing is unsourced. It only reads.
gallery.tip: Needs GitHub's MCP server as MCP_GITHUB in second-thought.ini, started with --read-only, and a token that can only read: the example ini shows how.
gallery.author: itsfja

fields.TEXT: (owner/name) for someone deciding whether to use or contribute to it. First read it: the file tree, the README, the main source files it names and a few open issues. Then write, under these headings: What it is; Concept; Maintainability; Security; Ease of use; Configurability; Extensibility; Three things to improve. Under each, say what you found and name the file, issue or pull request it came from, like (README.md) or (#12). Say plainly what you didn't read. Only read: don't create, change, comment on or merge anything.

every finding names the file, issue or pull request it came from; nothing is claimed that the agent's reading doesn't show; it says what wasn't read; plain words, with any technical term explained once
